faqs.question: Where is GKU’s agriculture faculty located?
faqs.answer: Guru Kashi University is at Talwandi Sabo in Bathinda district, Punjab.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. Agriculture?
faqs.answer: The programme page lists four years.

faqs.question: Can an agriculture diploma holder apply?
faqs.answer: The official course page includes qualifying two- or three-year agriculture/allied diploma routes after Class 10, subject to its 50% requirement.

faqs.question: What specialised practical units are documented?
faqs.answer: The faculty identifies protected cultivation, seed technology, vermicomposting and sericulture resources.

faqs.question: Which degree is covered by this ICAR record?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture under the Faculty of Agriculture, from 29 March 2024 to 28 March 2029.

faqs.question: Is an agriculture fee amount verified here?
faqs.answer: The course page provides no amount. The recovered 2025–26 scanned prospectus did not yield a verified agriculture fee in the inspected pages; a dated, itemised programme quote is still needed.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at GKU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/guru-kashi-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GKU?
faqs.answer: 4 years. A broad agriculture degree with published crop, resource and agribusiness subject areas.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GKU?
faqs.answer: Official page states 50% in 10+2 PCB/PCBM/PCM/Agriculture, or 50% in a two- or three-year agriculture/allied diploma after Class 10.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GKU?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. An academic-year-specific official fee schedule for this programme was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to GKU work?
faqs.answer: GKU’s general process moves from application and scrutiny to provisional allocation, eligibility verification, fee payment and final allotment. Submit the application: The procedure permits online or offline registration. Complete verification: Original documents are checked for eligibility before the university’s final seat allotment.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for GKU?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 180), recorded term 2024-03-29 to 2029-03-28. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at GKU?
faqs.answer: The faculty FAQ describes live projects, internships and field training. The facilities page identifies vermicomposting and silkworm-rearing units.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at GKU?
faqs.answer: Experimental and demonstration farms: Field areas support crop research and student training. Protected cultivation units: Polyhouses support horticultural and crop-diversification work. Seed technology and processing facilities: The faculty identifies seed testing, treatment and production research resources.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for GKU?
faqs.answer: Experimental and demonstration farms: Field areas support crop research and student training.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for GKU?
faqs.answer: GKU’s policy describes several fee-concession routes. Its early-admission windows are dated in 2026 and should not be treated as open-ended offers. Written confirmation of programme applicability and combination rules remains necessary. Special Meritorious Scholarship: The published policy sets first-semester tuition concessions by qualifying-class marks, excludes Ph.D. and restricts combination with government schemes or study packages. Confirm the applicable intake policy.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for GKU?
faqs.answer: GKU publishes university-wide placement support information. The general admissions page’s promotional placement wording is not a dated agriculture cohort report, so no agriculture placement rate or salary is quoted.

faqs.question: How can I contact GKU about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91 9914283400. Published email: info@gku.ac.in. Official admissions: https://gku.ac.in/admissions/admission-procedure

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for GKU?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://gku.ac.in/admissions/admission-procedure; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
